mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, increasing present value of future cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, signaling economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 105 signals robust manufacturing output, supporting corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during high supply activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption growth above 0.5% month-over-month indicates strong consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS MoM growth > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) combined with payroll growth exceeding 100,000 persons signals labor market tightness, potentially triggering wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with low unemployment
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS MoM growth > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production above 105 indicates strong manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 105, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
